records.name: Frameboxx Animation and Visual Effects
records.description: Frameboxx Animation and Visual Effects is an established animation training institute with centers across major Indian cities, offering diploma and advanced diploma programs in animation, VFX, and digital media. It provides industry-standard training on software including Autodesk Maya, Adobe Suite, and Nuke, preparing students for careers in film, television, and digital entertainment. Frameboxx is affiliated with Annamalai University for its diploma programs and has trained numerous animation professionals working in domestic and international productions.

records.name: Maya Academy of Advanced Cinematics (MAAC)
records.description: Maya Academy of Advanced Cinematics (MAAC) is one of India's largest professional training institutes for animation, visual effects, and film production, with centers across more than 100 cities. It offers programs ranging from short-term courses to advanced diploma programs in 3D animation, VFX compositing, character design, and game art. MAAC is backed by institutional partnerships and has produced animation professionals working on major Indian and international film productions.

records.name: National School of Drama
records.description: National School of Drama (NSD) New Delhi, established in 1959, is India's premier theatre training institution, autonomously functioning under the Ministry of Culture. It offers a three-year intensive full-time training program in theatre arts including acting, direction, stage design, and production, taught by India's most distinguished theatre practitioners. NSD has nurtured generations of India's finest actors, directors, and theatre artists who have shaped Indian theatre, cinema, and television.

records.name: Satyajit Ray Film and Television Institute
records.description: Satyajit Ray Film and Television Institute (SRFTI) Kolkata, established in 1995, is a premier film school under the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting, named after the legendary filmmaker and Academy Award recipient. It offers postgraduate diploma programs in direction, cinematography, editing, sound recording, and production design with a focus on artistic and independent filmmaking. SRFTI graduates have made critically acclaimed films and won awards at national and international film festivals.

records.name: Film and Television Institute of India
records.description: Film and Television Institute of India (FTII) Pune, established in 1960, is India's most prestigious film school and among Asia's finest, producing many of India's most celebrated filmmakers, actors, and cinematographers. It offers postgraduate diploma programs in direction, cinematography, editing, sound design, and acting within the historic Prabhat Studio complex. FTII alumni include legendary figures like Naseeruddin Shah, Jaya Bachchan, and Om Puri, and the institute has been central to the development of Indian parallel cinema.

records.name: Faculty of Fine Arts MSU Baroda
records.description: Faculty of Fine Arts at The Maharaja Sayajirao University of Baroda (MSU Baroda) Vadodara is one of India's most distinguished fine arts institutions, established in 1950, known for producing seminal Indian contemporary artists. It offers undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs in painting, sculpture, printmaking, photography, and art history. The Faculty has been central to the development of modern Indian art and continues to be a leading center for artistic practice and research.

records.name: College of Art Delhi
records.description: College of Art Delhi, established in 1942, is one of India's oldest and most respected fine arts colleges, affiliated with Indraprastha University. It offers BFA and MFA programs across painting, sculpture, applied arts, and art history, attracting students from across India. The college's location in the capital city provides exceptional access to national museums, galleries, and the arts community, enriching students' artistic development.

records.name: Kala Bhavana Santiniketan
records.description: Kala Bhavana, Visva-Bharati University, Santiniketan, was founded by Rabindranath Tagore in 1919 as a revolutionary arts and crafts institution that reimagined Indian art education by blending traditional Indian artistic traditions with modernist approaches. It offers BFA, MFA, and PhD programs in painting, sculpture, printmaking, and history of art, and is recognized as one of India's most creatively significant art institutions. Kala Bhavana's unique outdoor classroom tradition and association with Tagore's legacy make it a pilgrimage destination for artists and art lovers.

records.name: Government College of Fine Arts Chennai
records.description: Government College of Fine Arts Chennai, established in 1850, is one of Asia's oldest fine arts colleges, affiliated with the University of Madras and offering BFA and MFA programs. It is known for its strong traditions in South Indian classical painting, sculpture, and applied arts, training generations of Tamil Nadu's leading artists and art educators. The college's historical legacy and government support make it a premier destination for fine arts education in South India.

records.name: Indian Institute of Banking and Finance (IIBF)
records.description: Indian Institute of Banking and Finance (IIBF) Mumbai, established in 1928, is the apex body for professional development in the Indian banking and finance sector. It conducts the JAIIB (Junior Associate of the Indian Institute of Bankers) and CAIIB (Certified Associate of the Indian Institute of Bankers) examinations, which are near-mandatory qualifications for bank officers in India. IIBF also offers specialized certifications in areas such as credit management, trade finance, digital banking, and MSME finance.
